start.title: 天からの声
start.text:
神があなたに語りかけます。
「箱舟を造りなさい。洪水が来る。」

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Receive God's command to build an ark of cypress wood
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 6:14, 22 — God told Noah to make an ark of cypress wood, and Noah did everything just as God commanded.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Refuse the command and flee the land
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says Noah obeyed God; he did not flee.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Buy an existing ship from a merchant
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says Noah built the ark himself, as God instructed.

mockery.title: 見守る世界
mockery.text:
あなたの周りの世界は堕落し、暴力に満ちています。
彼らはあなたが造るのを見ています。あなたはどう応えますか？

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Keep building the ark by faith
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Hebrews 11:7 — By faith Noah built the ark in reverent fear, though warned of things not yet seen.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Abandon the ark to please the crowd
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Scripture says Noah kept building by faith.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Attack the mockers to silence them
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Scripture does not describe Noah attacking anyone.

building.title: ゴフェルの木とアスファルト
building.text:
あなたは神が命じた材料を集めます。
どのように箱舟を造りますか？

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Build it of cypress wood, coated with pitch inside and out
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 6:14 — Make yourself an ark of cypress wood; coat it with pitch inside and out.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Build it from cut stone
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says the ark was built of cypress wood, not stone.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Weave it from reeds like a basket
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says the ark was made of cypress wood, sealed with pitch.

ark_done.title: 完成した箱舟
ark_done.text:
箱舟は神が命じた通りに完成しました。
それはどのように見えますか？

choices.text: [TODO:ja] 300 cubits long, 50 wide, 30 high, with three decks
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 6:15-16 — The ark was 300 cubits long, 50 wide, 30 high, with three decks.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] A small round boat with one deck
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis gives specific dimensions; the ark was not a small round boat.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] A raft, flat and open to the sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says the ark had a roof, three decks, and a door in its side.

animals.title: 生き物たちが来る
animals.text:
動物たちが箱舟にやって来ます。
あなたは誰を乗船させますか？

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Take pairs of every kind of animal, male and female
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 7:8-9 — Pairs of clean and unclean animals, birds and creeping things came to Noah, male and female.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Take only sheep and goats
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says every kind of animal came, not only sheep and goats.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Take no animals — only your family
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says the animals came into the ark with Noah.

boarding.title: 閉ざされた扉
boarding.text:
箱舟に入る時が来ました。
誰が入り、誰が扉を閉めますか？

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Enter with your wife, three sons, and their wives; the Lord shuts the door
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 7:13, 16 — Noah, his wife, his three sons and their wives entered the ark, and the Lord shut him in.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Enter the ark alone, leaving your family behind
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says Noah's whole household entered the ark with him.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Stay outside and close the door from without
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says the Lord Himself shut Noah inside the ark.

storm.title: 四十日間の雨
storm.text:
天の窓が開きます。
何が起こりますか？

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Rain falls on the earth for forty days and forty nights
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 7:12 — Rain fell on the earth forty days and forty nights.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] A single storm passes in one day
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says the rain fell for forty days and nights.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Only a light drizzle falls
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis describes the fountains of the deep bursting and the windows of heaven opening.

inside.title: 水の上で
inside.text:
箱舟は深い水の上に浮かんでいます。
水はどれくらいの期間、地上に満ちていましたか？

choices.text: [TODO:ja] The waters flood the earth for a hundred and fifty days
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 7:24 — The waters flooded the earth for a hundred and fifty days.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] The waters recede in three days
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says the waters prevailed 150 days before receding.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] You steer the ark back toward Eden
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis does not describe Noah steering the ark; God kept it afloat.

dove.title: 鳩が戻る
dove.text:
水が引き始めます。
あなたはどのようにして乾いた土地が近いことを知りますか？

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Send out a dove; it returns with a fresh olive leaf
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 8:11 — The dove returned to Noah in the evening with a freshly plucked olive leaf.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Send out a raven that returns with grain
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says the dove — not the raven — brought back an olive leaf.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Open the roof and look with your own eyes only
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says Noah sent out birds to test whether the waters had gone down.

dry_land.title: 足元の地
dry_land.text:
主はあなたに箱舟から出るように言われます。
乾いた土地で最初に何をしますか？

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Build an altar to the Lord and offer sacrifices
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 8:20 — Noah built an altar to the Lord and offered burnt offerings on it.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Begin building a great tower right away
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says Noah's first act was to build an altar, not a tower.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Refuse to leave the ark
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says Noah came out of the ark when God told him to.

covenant.title: 虹
covenant.text:
虹が空にかかります。
「二度と私は地を洪水で滅ぼさない。これはあなたとの契約である。」
